scope: Selected sourced infrastructure disruptions; not a complete or statistically representative sample.

incidents.title: FAA national ground stop
incidents.cause: Legacy network instability associated with excessive data flooding; possible originating sites in Texas and Arkansas. FAA says no indication of cyberattack.
incidents.physical_effect: Flights grounded; communications and radar feeds unstable

incidents.title: Microsoft 365 service disruption
incidents.status: Service restored; full post-incident review pending
incidents.cause: Microsoft 365 service interruption; no verified causal link to FAA event.
incidents.physical_effect: Exchange Online and dependent services disrupted

labels.confirmed_cyber: Cyberattack confirmed by responsible organization or authority
labels.technical_failure: Responsible authority indicates equipment/software or operational fault
labels.service_outage: Disruption confirmed; malicious cause not established

methodology.baseline: No historical baseline exists yet. Do not calculate increases, coordination, incident rates, or cross-sector anomalies from this small curated list.
methodology.deduplication: One row per distinct real-world incident; do not count multiple articles as multiple events.
methodology.source_priority: Official postmortems > responsible operators > reliable independent reporting > social claims.
methodology.review: Update dates, source links, and classification as investigations progress.
